name: Loss-of-voltage monitoring relay
summary: A loss-of-voltage relay changes its output for a documented absence-of-voltage condition.
description: A loss-of-voltage relay changes its output for a documented absence-of-voltage condition. Schematics distinguish measurement failure, actual source loss and auxiliary-supply loss where the design requires them.
readingNotes: Trace the monitored voltage independently from relay auxiliary power.
The preview is an original explanation of this function. Match the actual drawing convention to its legend and the selected equipment documentation.
distinction: Loss-of-voltage indication is not necessarily the same function as breaker undervoltage release.
